Reflect the portions above the x-axis downwards; retain the portions below it.

answer.worked:
First sketch $y=|f(x)|$ by reflecting the portions below the $x$-axis upwards. Then reflect the whole graph across the $x$-axis to obtain $y=-|f(x)|$.

Thus the original portions below the $x$-axis remain unchanged, while the original portions above it are reflected downwards. Retain all four $x$-intercepts and the sharp joins there.
